source_classes.assumption: Engineering assumption with no single source. Listed so that it can be replaced by a measurement.

parts.identity: 3.0 mm bottom plate + 1.5 mm top plate, 3K carbon
parts.price_note: SendCutSend lists carbon fibre 'from $49' but only 1.0 and 1.6 mm on its standard list, so the 3.0 mm bottom plate needs a different cutter or a quote. Treated as a lower bound, not a quote.

sources.supports: carbon fibre parts from 49 USD; 1.0 and 1.6 mm standard thicknesses

carbon_plate.density_note: Typical cured 3K twill laminate. No supplier datasheet with a plate density was reached; the mass check is repeated at both ends of the range.
carbon_plate.modulus_note: One UK plate maker's 3K twill laminate (42 % resin) reports a 55.2 GPa tensile modulus; 40 GPa is used as a pessimistic lower bound.

usable_capacity_fraction.why: Land at about 3.7 V/cell under load; common LiPo practice.

avionics_power_w.why: FC + GPS + receiver + camera + VTX at 350 mW output; not measured.

mass_limit_g.why: EU C0 MTOM limit is 'less than 250 g'; FAA recreational registration exception is 'less than 250 grams'.

mass_design_margin_g.why: Kept free under the limit for scale error, glue, heat-shrink and a heavier cell.

min_tw_ratio.why: Lower bound for confident GPS/position-hold flight with wind margin on a 3-inch; racers run 6+.

min_prop_clearance_mm.why: Radial gap from a prop tip to any part that reaches the prop plane; above FDM/CNC tolerance and blade flex.

min_vertical_gap_mm.why: Gap from the top of the prop hub to anything above the prop disc.

max_cg_offset_mm.why: Horizontal CG offset from the thrust centre that the controller trims without visible motor saturation.

tip_mass_extra_g.why: Four M2x6 screws and a prop nut per arm.

regulation_sources.supports: Class C0: MTOM less than 250 g including payload, 19 m/s, 120 m
FAA: registration exception for drones under 250 g flown under the recreational exception
